issues.description: Required data routes, macro-generated panels, and several producer/consumer handoffs remain unresolved; direct reads outside the 53-edge checklist were added to the closure.

Custom autocall macros event, bharlog, crsp_day, SUE, ind_ff48 and Winsorize_Truncate are not supplied. *%event calls remain macro expansion uncertainty because SAS processes macro references in this comment form; do not infer disabled calls or their outputs.
SAS library/autocall locations and Stata working/output directories use hard-coded Windows paths without a verified runtime mapping.
QEA creates WORK comp_full_sample, while Customer Demand, Guidance, Pseudo, and Table 6 CF read DIS.comp_full_sample; no persistent DIS write is visible.
Pseudo Dates creates WORK pseudo_dates but Customer Demand reads DIS.pseudo_dates; the library handoff is not shown.
Customer Demand reads DIS.dates, but no supplied entry identifies the producer, source or coverage.
SAS leaves demand7 as a one-level dataset; the Table 2/7/S4 Stata companion uses demand7. No explicit DTA export/transfer is visible.
QEA creates WORK comp_jar3 and comments it is for Table 3–4, while Table 3-4.do reads cust_qea3; no such export is shown and DIS.comp_jar3 has no visible write.

QEA invokes loop5_5 once, applies Edgar and Google deletion blocks sequentially to the same qtrs2 object, then exports qtrs_Edgar and qtrs_SVI. Table 6 reads qtrs5_2_Edgar/SVI; exact filename/variant/branch compatibility is unknown.

actions.description: Confirm authorized WRDS products, vintages, fields and study-period coverage for the identified candidates, then map compatible inputs to the author filenames.
steps: Verify account products and extraction vintages against every author-named input; one-row probes establish selected columns/readability only.
Confirm customer IDs, CRSP company/industry coverage, Compustat quarterly history, CCM links, IBES actuals and summaries, S34, and Table 6 factors including ps_vwf.
Prepare only documented field/date mappings where the source is compatible; otherwise obtain the authorized product or author specification.
validation: Check bounded metadata for required columns, identifiers and dates after access is confirmed.
Confirm population and historical coverage before starting downstream stages.

actions.description: Obtain the author-prepared daily SVI, EDGAR activity, First Call, prelinked RavenPack, and DIS date inputs or their exact construction/access details.
steps: Request exact versions, variable definitions, identifiers, coverage dates, and authorized route for daily_svi4/daily_svi5, downloads_master/downloads_master2, cig, permno_events and DIS.dates.

For supplied prepared files, check bounded metadata against direct joins; if only a construction description is available, leave the data route unresolved until required fields/transforms are specified.
validation: Check required fields and date/identifier joins after files are authorized and available.
Confirm coverage with providers/authors; do not treat one-row probes as complete history.

actions.description: Obtain the author SAS autocall library and definitions, including EVENT behavior at asterisk-form calls.
steps: Request the referenced autocall directory and versions for event, bharlog, crsp_day, SUE, ind_ff48 and Winsorize_Truncate plus required macro variables.
Determine actual output datasets from the macro expansion; SAS documentation establishes that macro references are processed but does not establish their expansion.
Leave source calls unchanged until definitions and intended outputs are known.
validation: Perform future authorized macro lookup/trace and verify generated dataset names before full execution.

actions.description: Resolve SAS library assignments and all SAS-to-Stata dataset names before editing, retaining separate analyses and output variants.
steps: Ask whether comp_full_sample, pseudo_dates and dates should be persistent DIS datasets and identify their intended producers/periods.
Confirm demand7’s SAS-to-Stata transfer and whether comp_jar3 should feed cust_qea3.dta or a different named file.
Confirm qtrs5_2_Edgar/SVI versus qtrs_Edgar/SVI compatibility for Table 6; retain both variants pending clarification.
Map confirmed Windows libraries/output paths only after intended names and routes are known.
validation: Compare producer names, fields, identifiers and dates with every consuming SAS/Stata use.
Reconcile all six Stata companions with the correct upstream files.

actions.description: Establish SAS runtime and map supplied Windows library, autocall and output paths to accessible directories after input specifications are resolved.
steps: Confirm authorized SAS 9.4 startup and supported autoexec/library configuration; the bounded startup result is unverified.
Map required Windows data, autocall, Stata working and output directories without editing package sources.
validation: Check SAS startup, macro lookup and read/write access to every mapped directory before running author code.

actions.description: After sources, macros, paths, and handoffs are reconciled, preserve all five SAS builders and six independent Stata companions in producer/consumer order.
steps: Run QEA Dates first after resolving its direct inputs/macros because it builds the earnings/event/customer intermediates and quarterly sorts.
Run Customer Demand, Guidance Dates, and Pseudo Dates for their separate datasets, plus Table 6 CF Replication Final.sas for its CF and customer-sort exports.
Run all six Stata companions separately: Table 2/7/S4 Demand; Table 3-4; Table 5; Table 6; Table 8a pseudo; Table 8b guidance, after confirming each input handoff.
Keep QEA qtrs_Edgar/SVI and Table 6 qtrs5_2 variants distinct until author clarification confirms compatibility.
validation: Record each stage’s consumed/created names and check the next consumer receives compatible fields, identifiers and dates.
After future authorized execution, compare outputs from all six Stata companions with the paper and S1–S4 appendix.

review_notes: All five SAS builders and all six Stata companions are retained; Table 5 and Table 6 remain distinct QEA output consumers.
All 53 frozen dependency IDs were reviewed. Additional direct reads outside the checklist are represented as explicit requirements or issues.

Catalog candidates and bounded one-row probes establish discovery, selected readability, or columns only; they do not establish licenses, full historical coverage, or author-construction compatibility.
The asterisk-form *%event calls remain unresolved macro expansion/definition dependencies. Official SAS documentation says macro references in this comment form are processed.
No analysis_only scope is supported: the packaged workbook is an identifier list, not compatible full analysis data.
Static assessment only; no author program execution, dataset downloads, software installation, or source patches.
